entries.summary: Codebase Memory MCP documents a local code-intelligence server that connects source code, documentation, configuration and infrastructure in a persistent knowledge graph. It provides MCP tools and coding-agent integrations, including instructions, skills, profiles and supported hooks.
entries.selection_context: Use the publisher documentation to compare repository exploration, graph queries and change-impact analysis for a coding agent. Check the integration matrix for the specific client and platform; documented skills and hook support vary by client.
entries.limitations: Review installer changes to agent configuration and hooks, local indexing scope and storage, and release-verification instructions before use. CBM Lens is documented as an optional beta companion, and browser AI may download a model when enabled. Installation, security, performance and agent compatibility were not independently tested.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from the current discovery snapshot. The public upstream is active and documents relevant agent skills and hooks; omission from a bounded discovery query does not establish retirement.
